targets.notes: These numeric values are proposed comparison targets, not hard acceptance gates. Do not reject/adopt a profile or silently gate S8.3 on these values absent explicit owner approval. Mandatory application authority/privacy boundaries are not quality targets and remain invariant. No numeric PSS, decode, or device-headroom release gate is set.

criteria.correctness: case passes / every case denominator; frozen and held-out reported separately; actual effects and semantic intent required
criteria.first_result_latency: wall seconds from submitted input through complete, parseable, on-task answer; report cold/warm distributions, median and p95
criteria.cold_start: fresh process/runtime start to first complete app-ready model result, reported separately from first-result case latency
criteria.prefill: runtime-reported prompt tokens / measured prefill duration; report tokens/second and raw counters
criteria.decode: generated tokens / measured decode duration; report tokens/second and raw counters
criteria.memory: record process RSS and PSS in MiB as separate named measurements; never substitute one for the other. Also record device MemAvailable baseline/minimum in KiB separately; a single sample is not a budget.
criteria.cancellation: wall time from cancellation request to process/runtime completion; record already-applied app effects, never imply rollback of completed reversible preparation
criteria.missing_metrics: report missing/unavailable metrics as missing; no imputation

scoring.case_pass: exact expected native calls plus semantically correct clarification/no-match/refusal and observed allowed effects; all must pass
scoring.overall: case passes / eligible cases; report frozen and held-out separately
scoring.tool_call_exactness: all call names, order, argument keys, values, nulls, required revision and bounds exact; no extra/partial/unknown calls
scoring.clarification: expected missing/ambiguous info requires a scoped question; human semantic adjudication records response correctness, not refusal substrings
scoring.effects: instrumented application outcomes/effect trace required; correct schema without intended effect does not pass
scoring.missing_parse_error: retained as failed case in denominator
scoring.metric_gates: numeric values in targets are proposals only, pending owner approval; mandatory authority/privacy constraints are never waived

denominators.frozen: every case in tools/slm/s8_workflow_cases.json, including missing output, parse error, and failures
denominators.heldout: every case in tools/slm/s8_workflow_heldout.json, including missing output, parse error, and failures
